channel.title: WisdomAI Blog
channel.description: Comprehensive feed of all WisdomAI blog posts (40 items).

item.title: Connect WisdomAI in Claude
item.description: Now your team can keep asking questions right where they already work, and every answer comes back accurate, governed, and grounded in your business context.

item.title: Four Questions to Ask When You Interview at a Startup
item.description: So you landed a job interview? Congrats! Here are four questions you should ask to actually interview the startup instead of them just interviewing you.

item.title: From 93% to 100% Accuracy: The Last Mile of AI Analytics
item.description: One question, two right answers. See how one team used a context development lifecycle to take its AI analytics evaluation set from 94% to 100%.

item.title: Building the Benchmark: WisdomAI vs. Claude Code
item.description: Frozen questions, executed SQL, 3 runs per question. Get the methodology behind the benchmark and learn how to run the test on your data.

item.title: Why I stopped asking for dashboards
item.description: After 20 years in customer success, I stopped waiting on reports. Here's how I built a WisdomAI Live App that scores account health and recommends the next move.

item.title: Evaluating and improving consistency in AI agents
item.description: Lessons from my summer at WisdomAI building a consistency eval for our AI agent, including the wins, the dead ends, and what finally worked.

item.title: How WisdomAI caches queries for faster answers
item.description: A look inside WisdomAI's caching architecture, and how it speeds up Live Apps and Chat while cutting repeated queries and compute cost

item.title: How Live Apps Change the Way GTM Teams Act on Data
item.description: Forget static dashboards. See how our GTM leaders build Live Apps to analyze, forecast, and plan in one interactive surface, with just a few messages.

item.title: Introducing Apache Ossie Standard in WisdomAI
item.description: Bring your semantic model into WisdomAI with Apache Ossie import. Reuse your team's metric definitions, avoid fragmentation, and get answers you can verify.

item.title: Introducing Live Apps: The Live App I use to run WisdomAI
item.description: WisdomAI CEO Soham Mazumdar gives an inside look into the Live App he uses every day.

item.title: A Day in the Life of a SQL Query
item.description: Join WisdomAI Co-Founder and Chief Architect, Guilherme Menezes, as he unpacks why SQL generation is harder than it looks.

item.title: WisdomAI Now Available in ChatGPT Work
item.description: WisdomAI is now available in ChatGPT Work. See how you can leverage this partnership to scale trusted Agentic Analytics in the enterprise.

item.title: AI Readiness is Not the Same as Data Cleanliness
item.description: CPO Kapil Chhabra reflects on new research from over 200 enterprise leaders. See why context, not clean data, is the real key to trustworthy AI analytics.

item.title: WisdomAI Hackathon 2026: Highlights and Recap
item.description: WisdomAI Hackathon 2026 just wrapped. See what our engineering and dev teams built over 48 hours — solving real user friction.

item.title: How Wisdom Gets Text-to-SQL Right in Production
item.description: How Wisdom Gets Text-to-SQL Right in Production: Inside the Adaptive Context Engine

item.title: Introducing WisdomAI Analytics Agents
item.description: Meet the WisdomAI Analytics Agents. With autonomous workflows that reason across your data stack, you can bridge the gap between insight and action.

item.title: Our Manifesto to Transform Enterprise Data into Actionable Wisdom
item.description: Outlining the 5 Pillars we're committed to offering our customers to reinvent BI

item.title: WisdomAI and Google Cloud Join Forces to Turn Enterprise Data into Instant Insights
item.description: WisdomAI is proud to partner with Google Cloud to power smarter insights and analytics from the world's top enterprises.

item.title: Introducing Proactive Agents: Your Always-On AI Data Analyst
item.description: Introducing WisdomAI's Proactive Agents, your always-on AI data analyst. These agents work 24/7 to monitor metrics, detect anomalies, and prepare analyses, effectively augmenting your human data team without increasing headcount. Proactive Agents learn over time, surfacing only significant anomalies and freeing your team from manual monitoring, allowing them to focus on strategic projects and ensuring faster issue resolution.

item.title: The first Agentic Data Insights Platform
item.description: After tireless work building a solution we deeply believe in, we're thrilled to announce our $23M funding round.

item.title: Our Comprehensive Guide on Conversational BI for Teams and Businesses
item.description: Discover how conversational BI helps teams turn data into instant insights. See its key benefits, real-world use cases, and how to get started with WisdomAI.

item.title: Announcing our Federated Agentic Intelligence Platform
item.description: WisdomAI recently announced the launch of the Federated Agentic Intelligence Platform, introducing a new model for turning raw enterprise data into trusted decisions.

item.title: Announcing our $50M Series A funding led by Kleiner Perkins
item.description: WisdomAI secured $50 million in Series A funding, led by Kleiner Perkins, to advance its AI Data Analysts and autonomous AI Agents, shifting analytics from static dashboards to proactive, context-aware insights.
